rules.statement: A plaintiff claiming title by intestate succession must show affirmatively that the intestate estate was less than Rs. 1,000 in value; it is not sufficient that both parties ignore the necessity for administration or even agree that it is not necessary.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is incumbent on a plaintiff in that position to show affirmatively that the intestate estate was less than Rs. 1,000 in value. It is not sufficient that both parties ignore the necessity for administration, or even agree that administration was not necessary."
